WHEN THE GERMANS ENTERED BELGRADE THRU
AUSTRALIA ACROSS THE SAVE RIVER.

The Save or San River is the boundary separating Austria from Serbia. Across this river there was a magnificent steel bridge connecting Semlin, Austria with Belgrade, Serbia. When the Teuton forces made their assault on the Serbs, the latter in an effort to checkmate the entry into Belgrade of the Austrian and German troops, destroyed this magnificent steel structure and the invaders were compelled to resort to the use of small beats on getting into Belgrade. Many Austrian and German soldiers lost their lives in crossing the river in small boats. 11/30/1915.
